source_text: Μεταβῶμεν δὲ καὶ ἐπὶ ἑτέραν γνῶσιν καὶ διδαχήν. Ὁδοὶ δύο εἰσὶν διδαχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας, ἥ τε τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ ἡ τοῦ σκότους. διαφορὰ δὲ πολλὴ τῶν δύο ὁδῶν. ἐφ̓ ἧς μὲν γάρ εἰσιν τεταγμένοι φωταγωγοὶ ἄγγελοι τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐφ̓ ἦς δὲ ἄγγελοι τοῦ σατανᾶ. καὶ ὁ μέν ἐστιν κύριος ἀπὸ αἰώνων καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ὁ δὲ ἄρχων καιροῦ τοῦ νῦν τῆς ἀνομίας.
pass_a_gloss: Let us proceed to another knowledge and teaching. There are two ways of teaching and authority, the one of light and the one of darkness. There is a great difference between the two ways. For on the one, indeed, are stationed light-leading angels of God, on the other, angels of Satan. And the one is Lord from ages and to the ages, the other is ruler of the present time of lawlessness.

choices.why: indicating a choice between two options

pass_b_english: Let us move on to another subject of knowledge and teaching. There are two ways of teaching and authority: one of light and one of darkness, and the difference between them is immense. On the one hand, light-guiding angels of God are stationed; on the other, angels of Satan. The one is Lord from ages past and into the ages to come, while the other is the ruler of the present age of lawlessness.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source. The distinction between the Lord (eternal) and the ruler of the present time (temporal) is preserved. The translation of 'ἐφ̓ ἧς' as 'on the one' (Pass A) and 'on the one hand' (Pass B) correctly captures the relative pronoun's function in the context of the two ways.
